title: Eagle Mayfair Panel Bed – Vertical Panel Upholstered Bed Frame
descriptionHtml:
The Mayfair Vertical Panel Bed is an upholstered bed frame with a clean, tailored look that suits a period conversion or a new-build bedroom. Deep vertical panels run the full height of the headboard, with matching detailing on the footboard, and it is handmade to order in Dewsbury.

Key features

  • Deep vertical panel headboard and footboard
  • Plush Velvet, Naples or Chenille upholstery
  • 15+ colours available
  • Optional ottoman gas-lift storage
  • Free fabric swatches

Sizes and prices

Single (3FT) £311.99; Small Double (4FT) £324.99; Double (4FT6) £337.99; King (5FT) £349.99; Super King (6FT) £389.99. Not sure which size you need? See our bed sizes guide.

Materials & build

Built and upholstered by hand in our own workshop in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire. Fabrics: Plush Velvet, Naples or Chenille, in 15+ colours. Free fabric swatches let you check colours at home.

Mattress

Takes a standard UK mattress in the size you choose. Browse our mattresses, such as the 3000 Pocket Sprung Mattress or the Memory Foam Mattress.

Delivery, returns & warranty

Delivery is free across Great Britain (England, Scotland and Wales), made by our own team, and usually takes 3-5 working days. Northern Ireland delivery is £90. You have 14 days to return an unused, unassembled item in its original packaging, with free collection. A faulty item is replaced or fully refunded. Every bed has a 5-year frame warranty. Pay in instalments with Klarna or Clearpay at checkout. Questions? Call 07417 439197 (Mon-Fri, 9am-6pm) or email eaglebedofficial@gmail.com.

Frequently asked questions

Does the bed have a footboard?

Yes. The footboard matches the headboard's vertical panel detailing.

Can I get ottoman storage?

Yes. Ottoman gas-lift storage is available as an option. See our ottoman beds for more.

When will it arrive?

Delivery is free across Great Britain and usually takes 3-5 working days; Northern Ireland is £90.

Can I return it if it is not right?

Yes. Returns are free within 14 days if it is unused and unassembled in its original packaging, and faulty items are replaced or refunded in full.

Can I see the fabric first?

Yes. Free fabric swatches are available, so you can see the colour in your own light before ordering.
